entry.title: XRCC 4.1.0.2 Release
entry.content:
New features

  • Added Behaviour Tidy / Auto-Organize in the PC Behaviour Panel
  • Added duplicate behaviour group in the PC Behaviour Panel
  • Added Quiz behaviours: Start Quiz, On Quiz Start, and Get Quiz Property (question count, quiz finished, correct answer count)

Updated

  • Improved Quiz Editor user experience, including question validation, AI suggestions, Make Similar, project source, and layout
  • Updated Debug Panel Watch Tab UI on PC and XR
  • Improved unique naming when creating or duplicating items
  • Updated Skybox/ambient lighting so only directional environment lights are toggled; point and spot lights stay on
  • Updated camera focus on light object

Fixed

  • Fixed packaged scene lighting not applying correctly when loading or switching scene assets, and when entering or leaving play mode
  • Fixed player wand remaining enabled when the XR panel is closed
  • Fixed Open Debug Review After Play Mode setting inverted usage
  • Fixed tooltips, including Chinese text and display order
  • Fixed File Browser selection when deselecting the last file with Ctrl

entry.title: XRCC 4.1.0 Release
entry.content:
New features

  • Project Source
    • Create Project Sources to reuse as context for AI Quiz and AI Characters
    • Upload documents and use AI to extract key information to use in project sources
    • Analyze and reanalyze Project Sources
    • Set source focus and review source revisions / processing warnings
  • Added Quiz object
    • Quiz object
      • Added Quiz Special Object
      • Spawn Quiz object from Asset Panel under Special Object
      • Edit questions in the Quiz Editor Panel
      • Configure runtime quiz panel appearance and theme
    • AI quiz generation
      • Generate questions with AI from Project Sources
      • Generate multiple questions and edit generated results
    • Quiz scoping with AI Character chat
      • Integrate with AI Character for quiz workflows
      • Dynamically scope the quiz question list based on AI Character chat content
  • Added Asset Property editing and file replacement in the Asset Panel
    • Edit asset name, description, tags, and license
    • Replace asset source files for a selected asset
    • Multi-select batch edit with mixed-value support
    • Model pivot recentering and Sketchfab source metadata display
  • Added Behaviour System features
    • Added dynamic-size behaviour blocks
    • Added behaviour block tooltip descriptions
    • Added auto-snap with axis-lock placement
  • Added Runtime Debug Panel for PC and XR to inspect watched variables, change logs, and behaviour warnings in Debug and Play modes
  • Added Capture Thumbnail On Save toggle in Settings

Updated

  • Updated AI Character with advanced settings panel, source grounding, and improved Auto-type prompt generation
  • Updated Poe API key panels to UI Toolkit and prevented duplicate API key names on create
  • Restricted Poe speech-to-text to English, Mandarin, and Cantonese
  • Improved Asset Panel sorting so assets from the same pack are grouped together
  • Updated Asset Inspector, Replace Asset File, License Viewer, and Sketchfab source display UI
  • Required unique names when renaming assets and instances, and kept AI Character instance names in sync
  • Added loading package status text during package load
  • Blocked selected editor operations while a project is saving

Fixed

  • Fixed microphone StartRecording reusing a stale recording file
  • Fixed wand detection for floor and wall layers
  • Fixed player unable to walk up stairs
  • Fixed LaserPointer raycast and highlight to match Wand on floor and wall layers
  • Fixed item tags not displaying correctly in the Item Panel
  • Fixed changing scene failing after loading a packaged model
  • Fixed XR Debug mode returning to home without cleaning up the info wall
  • Fixed light probe groups and startpoint lighting not loading from packages
  • Fixed measurer lines and reporter captured images not clear up in XR mode
  • Fixed behaviours not stopping when changing mode
  • Fixed Save As producing an invalid project archive
  • Fixed Import Package panel scroll lag
  • Fixed MCU setup panel rendering above the fader in XR
  • Fixed file browser restoring a cached path on project save, and UI Toolkit panels remaining open over the file browser
  • Fixed tooltips not cleaning up and the save button showing the wrong icon after save
  • Fixed Dialog panel failing to load during a lag spike
  • Fixed blinker null reference when a model material is missing

entry.title: XRCC 4.0 Release
entry.content:
New Features

  • XRCC Launcher Integration - Launch project and communicate with XRCC Launcher
  • AI Generation with Poe AI integration (Text-to-Image, Text-to-Sound, Text-to-Music, and AI Characters)
  • Poe AI integration with behaviours (Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Text, and AI Chat)
  • External Connection System (Poe, Wit.ai, Microcontroller/MCU including Microbit via BLE, and Remote Trigger)
  • Item Tagging System with behaviours
  • Headmount play mode support in PC mode
  • Behaviour search

Updated

  • UI/UX overhaul on most panels
  • Improved Network Mode stability
  • Improved Asset & Package import system with in-app import and background loading
  • Improved file validation for asset import
  • Improved transitions and dialogs
  • Updated MCU / Microcontroller panels and connection UI
  • Added Screenshot Capture on save project in local mode
  • Added some behaviours with variable
  • Removed ReadyPlayerMe support

Fixed

  • Fixed user unable to visualize ground collider and import scene issue
  • Fixed XR UI dialog panel flickering
  • Fixed package import error when closing asset panel during import
  • Fixed filename check wrongly applied to network projects
  • Fixed File Browser crash / freeze when there are too many files on the device
  • Fixed scene not unloaded properly on network disconnect
  • Fixed project / scene thumbnail capture and display issues
  • Fixed multiple UI positioning, z-depth, and navigation problems
  • Fixed Play / VR mode button and dialog issues
  • Fixed tooltip appearing behind other UI elements
  • Fixed ground collider visualization and collision

entry.title: XRCC 3.1.4 Release
entry.content:
New

  • Added Import Project As New Scene: You can now import external projects directly as new scenes within your active project.
  • Added Clean-up Unused Assets: Added a feature to automatically clear out imported assets that are not currently in use.
  • Added Sparks License: The Sparks watermark will appear in the bottom-right corner during both Edit and Play modes when using a Sparks license.
  • Added XR Project Loading Progress Text: You will be able to track the project’s loading progress while in XR mode.
  • Added new Component Properties in Behaviour Block

Updated

  • Merged some old behaviour block into new Component Properties Block
  • Updated Microbit connection backend to increase stability
  • Updated VotanicXR SDK to 2020.10.4f2
  • Updated various Behaviour Blocks

Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where character model has unexpected offset / floating when the character model included self-control animators
  • Fixed an issue where position of pop up panel not accurate after changing resolution of XRCC
  • Fixed an issue where the scan button icon will keep rotate in the Microbit Panel after scanning for 30s or more
  • Fixed an issue where Microbit ReadData feature will receive garbage data
  • Fixed an issue where the "Animation Loop" attribute of models will get error when the project upgrade from version 3.1.1 to 3.1.2
  • Fixed an issue where error occurs when loading images during upgrade project to 3.1.3
  • Fixed an issue where incorrect Keyboard shortcut display in shortcuts Panel
  • Fixed an issue where User Movement speed not applying correct units 
  • Fixed an issue where Wit ai panel not blocking underlying UI 
  • Fixed an issue where user is unable to deselect items with Ctrl during multi-selection 
  • Fixed an issue where Instance Panel not snapping to child objects when selected 
  • Fixed an issue where inspector flashing for one frame during scene changes in Debug/Play mode 
  • Fixed an issue where scene unloading before fade effect completes 
  • Fixed various BLE-related crashes issues
